sloka: युद्ध्यातां तु ततस्तेषां वानराणां महात्मनाम् ।रक्षसां सम्बभूवाथ बलकोपः सुदारुणः ।। ६.४३.१ ।।।।
transliteration: yuddhyātāṁ tu tatasteṣāṁ vānarāṇāṁ mahātmanām ।rakṣasāṁ sambabhūvātha balakopaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।। 6.43.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the gigantic army of Vanaras were fighting with exceedingly terrific Rakshasas and the anguished Rakshasas could not tolerate the sight.
